# OpenShell

> OpenShell is an open-source desktop shell (Rust + Tauri 2) that turns any web app into a native desktop app. An app is a normal project folder: a web frontend, services in any language (Python, Node.js, Java, C++, Go, Rust, .NET) and an `openshell.json`. OpenShell starts and supervises the services, shows the frontend in a native window, reloads on code changes, builds installers and exposes the app to AI agents over MCP – in an "app" profile (use the app's own functions) and a "full" profile (develop it: logs, services, files, UI automation).

Key facts for building apps: services read `PORT` and bind `127.0.0.1`, answer `GET /health`, store data in `OPENSHELL_DATA_DIR`; the frontend calls the backend via relative `/api` URLs; app functions become agent tools via `capabilities`, `openapi` or frontend actions. CLI: `openshell create|init|dev|status|logs|call|build|package|mcp|guide`. All docs in one file: llms-full.txt.

## Building apps

- [AI app development guide](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/ai/app-development.md): app contract, workflow, verification commands, config cheat sheet, pitfalls (also `openshell guide`)
- [Getting started](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, create, run
- [Building blocks](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/building-blocks.md): frontend, backend, built-in database, script functions – combine freely (`openshell create --with`, `openshell add`)
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md): a complete app step by step
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): every field of openshell.json
- [Languages](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/languages.md): Java, Spring Boot, C++/CMake, Go, Rust, .NET
- [Installers](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/installers.md): openshell package
- [Platforms](https://github.com/RobinsSuperSchmiede/EDA/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): desktop, server, Android (platform adapters, `platforms`, lifecycle, remote gateway, device mesh)
